body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 4 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. The target gains +1 Fortitude against the next attack targeting it and reduces its next incoming forced movement by 2 units until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: Move the target 1 unit along a clear path.
The target reduces its next incoming Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Strain - Barrier
rider.html: If you accepted Strain, choose the first visible attacker to miss the protected creature before your next turn; impose -1 on its next Success Die before your next turn.
